title: Law 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: Vietnam AI Law took effect on 2026-03-01 and establishes healthcare AI as a high-risk category requiring specific compliance obligations.
limitations: Exact scope and requirements depend on implementing decrees; medical device classification may require separate assessment.

title: Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg high-risk AI list
supports_claim: Vietnam publishes its official high-risk AI list including healthcare applications with specific requirements for conformity assessment and human oversight.
limitations: Healthcare AI use cases must be mapped to the full official list; title alone is insufficient for classification.

title: EU AI Act implementation timeline
supports_claim: The Commission confirms healthcare AI as a high-risk area under Annex III with obligations applying from August 2027 for high-risk systems.
limitations: Implementation dates and guidance may be updated; re-check before deployment planning.

title: IBM Watson Oncology $4 billion failure analysis
supports_claim: IBM Watson Health cost $4 billion to develop but was sold for $1 billion in 2022 after MD Anderson Cancer Center discontinued its $65 million pilot in 2018 due to failures in meeting goals.
limitations: This is secondary analysis of public information; IBM's internal documentation is not publicly available.

title: Racial Bias in Healthcare AI: What It Is and How to Address It
publisher: NPR/Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
supports_claim: AI systems in healthcare can perpetuate racial bias by learning from historical data that reflects systemic disparities in care delivery.
limitations: Research focuses on US healthcare context; applicability to Vietnam requires local validation.

title: FDA Guidance on Medical Device Algorithms and Bias Mitigation
supports_claim: FDA provides guidance for medical device manufacturers on evaluating and mitigating racial and ethnic bias in AI/ML-enabled devices.
limitations: Guidance is voluntary framework not mandatory regulation; FDA jurisdiction applies to US market only.
